remarks: Beautifully renovated and designed for effortless entertaining, this spacious Sky Harbor home offers an airy, clean, modern feel with inviting spaces inside and out. New luxury vinyl plank flooring, new kitchen cabinets, renovated bathrooms, and a striking entryway accent wall create a fresh, cohesive look throughout. An additional bonus room offers flexibility for a guest retreat, home office, or potential extra bedroom. Enjoy your own pickleball court and an expansive lot with generous front and backyard space for gathering, outdoor dining, and relaxing.
